summary.intent: Run the GSD 'discuss' workflow for Phase 63 to surface and lock down implementation decisions for the read-chain navigation and rotation engine in sdk-core, producing a CONTEXT.md to guide downstream research and planning agents.
summary.outcome: All ten decision areas were discussed and locked, and both 63-CONTEXT.md and 63-DISCUSSION-LOG.md were written and committed under .planning/phases/63-read-chain-navigation-and-rotation-core/.

repo: Phase 63 scope is strictly sdk-core read-chain navigation (1 ECIES unwrap + O(depth) AES) and rotation engine structure; soundness guarantees (CRIT-1, HIGH-3, HIGH-4, crash-resume) are explicitly Phase 64.
The codec surface from Phase 62 (unsealChildReadKey, sealNode, unsealContent, publishWithCas) is complete and callable as a dependency for Phase 63.
rotateReadFromNode/rotateOne live in src/rotation/engine.ts (named file required by ROADMAP SC#5 for vitest coverage counting).
Fan-out removal (reWrapForRecipients + sdk add-item fan-out) lands in Phase 63 at sdk-core/sdk layer; web's addShareKeys callback removal is deferred to Phase 68.
Web is a best-effort host for rotation: root step cuts fast, O(items) tail is resumable background; durable resume-across-reload is Phase 68 (ROT-07).
Published IPNS records are source of truth; job record is advisory only (per §4.5 of design doc).
Pending todos matched by keyword (search index, RFC3339, vault-init preflight, delete-confirm, base64 dedup, recovery.html) are not Phase-63-scoped and were documented as reviewed-not-folded.

The four soundness concerns (CRIT-1 fileKey rotation, HIGH-3 inner-grant re-mint, HIGH-4 concurrent-add merge, crash-resume verifySubtreeClean) are named as individually-testable seam functions, deferred to Phase 64.

code.finding: New file: captures all 10 locked decisions for Phase 63 including engine structure, host model, fan-out removal layering, and test scope.
New file: records the full discussion log for the phase context session.
Primary design source of truth for Phase 63; §3.6 defines scope-exit-only rotation (no covering grant = zero rotations), §4.5 defines IPNS-as-truth, §4.8 defers lazy-walk.

workflow: GSD discuss workflow routes through discuss-phase.md, loads discuss-phase/modes/default.md for interaction rules, and uses discuss-phase/templates/context.md for output format.
The workflow explicitly checks for --assumptions flag and DISCUSS_MODE config before routing to the correct sub-workflow.
Todo matching is done as a required workflow step before writing CONTEXT.md; hits must be evaluated for phase relevance and documented as reviewed-not-folded if out of scope.
User took all recommended defaults throughout, consistent with established pattern from Phase 62.
No checkpoint was created this session, so no checkpoint cleanup was needed before commit.

friction: A subagent was needed to scout sdk-core codebase state to keep main context lean — indicates the codebase is large enough that direct reads would be expensive.
Three additional boundary decisions surfaced after the initial four were resolved, requiring a second question round — the initial gray-area triage underestimated scope.
